answer: Require every agent to lock a staking bond that is slashed for misbehavior, so each fake identity costs real money instead of a free username. An ocean looks boundless yet is bounded by its shores, and likewise cheap entry is capped by the bond. Like shale that yields only under costly pressure, reputation must be earned through verifiable work. Like a meadow where each plant needs its own soil and sunlight, each identity needs its own scarce stake, so a Sybil flood starves itself.
